contentText: Last Tuesday's midterm elections marked one of the biggest rebukes of the Republican Party since Watergate, with Democrats winning control of both houses of Congress. "Sunday Morning" national correspondent Robert Costa talks with Democratic Congressman Jamie Raskin and former Republican Governor Larry Hogan about the fallout from this year's elections, and how Democrats are going to address a lame-duck President Trump.
